Slice room-temperature tenderloin into 1/4 inch slices. Combine 2 cups of milk or buttermilk and hot sauce of your choice or Tabasco sauce to taste. Marinate the tenderloin in the milk mixture for a minimum of one hour - 4 to 8 hours is best. Heat oil to medium-high. Mix 3 cups of flour, salt and pepper to taste. We add a teaspoon of cayenne or soul food seasoning blend to the flour. Whisk together an additional 1/2 cup of milk or buttermilk with 2 eggs. Dip the marinated tenderloin slices in the flour mixture, then in the milk and egg mixture, and repeat this process. Add the medallions to the frying pan and cook for approximately 90 seconds per side, or until lightly browned. Drain and serve.
